name: ARDY Core RP 20FPS
description: NVIDIA ARDY, the real-time autoregressive successor to Kimodo. Starts exactly from the current pose.

code.install: Install ARDY into ComfyUI's Python environment: 'pip install git+https://github.com/nv-tlabs/ardy' (needs CMake and a C++ compiler for its motion-correction extension), then restart ComfyUI. The text encoder uses the gated meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct model: request access on Hugging Face and run 'hf auth login' once. See docs/VNCCS_POSE_STUDIO_TEXT_TO_MOTION.md.

requirements.notes: Most of the memory is the LLM2Vec text encoder (~14 GB in bfloat16); the motion model itself is small and generates in real time.

guide.summary: Recommended. NVIDIA's newest model: generates in real time and starts exactly from the pose you made, up to 10 s.
guide.best_for: Continuing your pose; walking, gestures, everyday actions; quick iterations
guide.setup_effort: Easy-medium: one Install button (needs CMake and a C++ compiler) plus a one-time Hugging Face access request

setup.label: ARDY Python package
setup.detail: Installed with ComfyUI-Manager. Building it needs CMake and a C++ compiler. ARDY requires transformers 5.8.1 and numpy below 2, which replace the versions in ComfyUI's Python (and conflict with Kimodo's transformers 5.1.0).

setup.label: Access to Meta Llama 3 8B Instruct (gated)
setup.detail: ARDY's text encoder is built on Meta Llama 3. Open the model page, accept the license with your Hugging Face account, then log in once from ComfyUI's Python environment.

setup.label: Model and text encoder (~17 GB)
setup.detail: Downloaded by ARDY itself on the first generation, so the first run takes a while.
